en.headline: Lee delivers Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and Policy Address
en.dek: The chief executive began presenting both documents at the Legislative Council at 11am, after a two-month consultation that drew tens of thousands of submissions.
body: Chief Executive John Lee began delivering Hong Kong’s first Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development, covering 2026 to 2030, together with the 2026 Policy Address, at a Legislative Council meeting at 11am on Wednesday.

The government had said the two documents would be released to the public on the same day. Lee told reporters on Tuesday that the five-year plan has a blue cover, which he said stood for openness, progress and stability, while the Policy Address keeps a green cover for continuity, vitality and hope. He said the two texts together run to more than 100,000 Chinese characters.

Lee said on Tuesday that the five-year plan would set strategic directions and priorities, including both binding and anticipatory indicators, and was not a planned economy. He has also said Hong Kong would keep its capitalist system, the rule of law and “One Country, Two Systems”.

China Daily, citing Lee, reported that the five-year plan consultation received about 17,000 submissions and the Policy Address about 11,000, after more than 100 consultation sessions. After the LegCo presentation he is scheduled to explain the documents at a press conference, broadcast forums and a question-and-answer session at the legislature.

zh.headline: 李家超在立法會發表首份五年規劃及施政報告
zh.dek: 行政長官今早11時在立法會宣讀《香港首個五年規劃》及2026年《施政報告》，兩份文件合共逾十萬字。
body: 行政長官李家超今日上午11時在立法會大會，發表《香港特別行政區經濟社會發展首個五年規劃》（2026至2030年）及2026年《施政報告》。
政府早前宣布兩份文件於同日向公眾發表。李家超周二見記者時展示藍色封面的五年規劃，稱代表開放、進步與穩健；《施政報告》維持綠色封面，代表延續、活力與希望。他指兩份文件合共超過十萬漢字。
他周二重申，五年規劃是訂出策略方向和優次的藍圖，會有約束性及預期性指標，並非計劃經濟，香港會繼續維持資本主義制度、法治及「一國兩制」。
《中國日報》引述他表示，五年規劃諮詢接獲約17,000份意見，《施政報告》約11,000份，期間舉行逾100場諮詢。宣讀後他將出席記者會、電視及電台節目，並在立法會互動答問，解釋內容。
